    data = df[bm].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    for k in [2, 3]:
        gm = GaussianMixture(n_components=k, random_state=42)
        gm.fit(data)
        labels = gm.predict(data)
        means = [data[labels==i].mean() for i in range(k)]
        weights = gm.weights_
        bic = gm.bic(data)
        print(f"{bm} k={k}: means={np.round(means,1)}, weights={np.round(weights,2)}, BIC={bic:.0f}")

print("\n=== Cluster means for ReadmissionRate (2-cluster solution) ===")

    gm = GaussianMixture(n_components=2, random_state=42)
    labels = gm.fit_predict(data)

    gm_cluster.name = f'{bm}_cluster'
    combined = pd.concat([df['ReadmissionRate'], gm_cluster], axis=1)
